card.name: Verbs of causing a bad outcome for someone
card.fires_on: Verbs like put, get and getting (and the words right after them) that describe a consequence landing on a person, such as risk, tenure, detention or admission. It is mostly in general web prose about consequences.

modes.label: Consequence verbs
modes.description: The verb put or get that leads into an outcome for a person.
modes.example: throw the entire case into doubt and<< put>> the applicant at risk of

modes.label: Words following the verb
modes.description: Small words right after the verb or in risk phrases, such as the, an, of, danger.
modes.example: be called forward to corroborate these answers. Any deviation from the testimony would prolong questioning or throw the entire case into doubt and put the applicant at risk<< of>>

card.plain: It lights up on words like put or get when a text says an action will bring a result or risk to someone.
evidence: throw the entire case into doubt and<< put>> the applicant at risk of
swearing in Ms. Craven’s class will<< get>> you a detention
affect a student’s chances of<< getting>> into college or getting a job
